subject: MAP kickoff: alignment & evaluation triage
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Oliver Singh <oliver.singh@novago.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 18 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP kickoff: alignment & evaluation triage

Hi Oliver —

Thanks again for the conversation last week. To keep momentum toward the Q4 close, wed like to run a short MAP kickoff next week to:
- Align stakeholders on success criteria and the evaluation plan
- Confirm roles and decision timelines
- Walk through a draft agenda and required evidence (security & performance)

Proposed window: Thu Jul 22, 10:00-11:00 PT (we can shift to your EMEA folks if needed). I attached a concise draft agenda and a starter evaluation checklist so you can circulate internally.

Could you confirm:
1) Who from Novago will own the evaluation (technical lead + procurement contact)?
2) Any additional attendees (security/compliance) to include on the invite?
3) If the proposed time works, well send a calendar hold with a Zoom link and a one-page MAP doc.

Im ccing Marissa (CS lead) and Monica (solutions engineering) so they can confirm staffing and ops details.

Thanks —

Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachment: 20260718-draft-map-agenda.pdf (PDF, 1 page)
Attachment: novago-eval-criteria.xlsx (Excel, 5 rows)
From: Oliver Singh <oliver.singh@novago.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Reddy <priya@novago.com>, security@novago.com
Date: Sat, 18 Jul 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: alignment & evaluation triage

Ben —

Thanks, this looks good. Thu Jul 22 at 10:00 PT should work for the core team. Ill confirm two things on our side:
- Evaluation owner: Priya Reddy (product ops) will lead the checklist + coordinate the technical evaluation.
- Security contact: Im looping our InfoSec mailbox (security@novago.com) — theyll want a short pre-read on data retention and access controls.

Two quick asks: can you include a brief section in the MAP (one slide) that states what logs/audit artifacts Redwood can deliver and retention windows? Also please call out the decision-maker who will sign on the commercial terms.

If you can send a calendar hold with the Zoom link and the agenda updated with attendee roles, well accept and invite the procurement lead.

Best,
Oliver
VP Product Operations
Novago Health

- Marissa Cole (Customer Success) — session lead / MAP owner
- Monica Patel (Solutions Engineering) — technical walkthrough + eval support
